name: raw_ticks
sql: select t.id, t.book, t.event_id, t.market, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status from ten287_rec.ticks t where t.event_id = 74753332 order by t.book, t.book_updated_at, t.id

name: raw_polls
sql: select book, max(processed_at) filter (where status_code = 200) last_ok from ten287_rec.requests where kind = 'updated' group by 1

name: kibl_sweep
sql: select max(started_at) from public.kibl_sweeps where ok

name: rpc
sql: select public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days') j
